insights.title: Data protection in Kenya: five steps every business should take
insights.summary: The Data Protection Act, 2019 applies to almost every organisation that handles personal data. This briefing sets out the practical steps that reduce risk and build trust with customers and staff.

insights.title: Buying property in Kenya: a due diligence checklist
insights.summary: Most land disputes can be traced to checks that were skipped before money changed hands. Here is what a careful buyer verifies before signing and paying.

insights.title: Ending employment fairly: what the Employment Act requires
insights.summary: A valid reason and a fair procedure are both essential. We explain the employer’s obligations on termination, redundancy and final dues.

insights.title: Succession in Kenya: planning ahead and administering an estate
insights.summary: How a will, a grant of representation and confirmation of grant fit together, and why acting early protects the people you leave behind.
